name: a-vector-left-open-is-refused-naming-where-it-opened-and-its-closer
raises:
::quote/ParseError!{
  :source "[1 2 3"
  :marker "      ^"
  :message "`[` opened at line 1, column 1 is never closed; `]` completes the source"
  :expected ["]"]
  :location ::span[6 1 7 6 1 7]
}
